text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During a partner run with Satono Diamond several days before her debut race, Kitasan Black finds herself finishing first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Satono Diamond finds it strange she couldn't overtake Kitasan Black, like she usually is able to…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's confidence is bolstered by the fruition of her training, and she looks forward to her debut.
